npc.runecraftory.skill_merchant.1.dating: You have feelings for me? Fascinating... I must admit, I had not anticipated this development. Yet I cannot say the thought displeases me. There is much about you I have come to appreciate, %player%. Yes, I would like that.
I have spent a considerable amount of time studying the mysteries of this world, yet somehow you have managed to become one of the more interesting things in my life. I accept.
How unusual. I have always preferred to keep others at a distance, yet I find myself rather reluctant to do so with you. Very well. Let us see where this leads.
I see. You have my gratitude for your honesty, but I fear I cannot return those feelings. Some paths are simply not meant to be walked together.
An unexpected confession. I think highly of you, %player%, but I have no desire to pursue a romantic relationship. I hope this changes little between us.
I am flattered, but my life is not particularly suited to such attachments. There are matters I cannot afford to become distracted from.
npc.runecraftory.skill_merchant.1.defaul: A gift? How unexpected. Thank you. I shall consider what purpose it might serve.
npc.runecraftory.skill_merchant.1.dislik:
Not particularly useful to me, I'm afraid. 

Still, I recognize the gesture. Thank you.
npc.runecraftory.skill_merchant.1.divorc: I see. Then our paths shall diverge. I will not attempt to change your mind. Some things, even when understood, cannot be undone.
An unfortunate conclusion. I had hoped our story would take a different course, but I shall respect your decision. Farewell, %player%.
Perhaps this was inevitable. Even the strongest bonds are not immune to the passage of time. I wish you well, wherever your path may lead.
Divorce? An interesting concept to bring up when no marriage exists. Have you perhaps mistaken me for someone else?
You cannot undo a bond that was never formed, %player%. Even the simplest principles of magic follow this rule.
Curious. I don't recall a wedding taking place. Unless there is something you know that I do not?
Ah... a new visitor. Welcome. I am %npc%. 
I deal in knowledge that cannot always be found in books, and abilities that cannot simply be learned through practice. If you seek powers beyond the ordinary, perhaps we have something to discuss.

Greetings, traveler. 
I assume you haven't come here by accident. 
I offer techniques, magical abilities, and knowledge that most would consider... rather uncommon. Take your time looking around. Some opportunities only present themselves once.

So, you've found your way here. Interesting. I'm %npc%. 
I trade in skills and magic, though I suspect the word merchant doesn't quite capture what I do. After all, not everything of value can be measured in gold.

Welcome. You needn't be suspicious. 
Well... no more suspicious than necessary. I have a collection of abilities and teachings that might interest someone like you. Whether you're ready to use them is another matter entirely.
npc.runecraftory.skill_merchant.1.follow: I must decline. There are matters here that require my attention, and not all of them can wait.
Not this time. I have some rather delicate research to attend to. Perhaps another opportunity will present itself.
An interesting offer, but I prefer to remain here for now. There are things you wouldn't understand.
So our journey ends here. Very well. There is still much to be done, and I suspect we shall meet again.
I shall return to my affairs. Do be careful, %player%. Knowledge is of little use to the dead.
A worthwhile excursion, perhaps. You have given me something to think about. Until next time.
Something on your mind, %player%? Curiosity is useful, but do try not to let it cloud your judgment.
Keep your attention focused. The world has a habit of revealing things when one least expects it.
There is much to learn from the places we visit. Try to observe more than you speak.
An invitation? How intriguing. Very well, I shall accompany you. There may be something worth discovering along the way.
I suppose a change of scenery would be beneficial. Besides, I have a feeling this journey may prove... enlightening.
Very well, %player%. I will join you. Though I should warn you, I have little interest in unnecessary heroics.
npc.runecraftory.skill_merchant.1.greeti:
Ah, %player%. Our paths cross once more. 
Have you put your newly acquired knowledge to good use?

Welcome back. 
I trust your abilities have served you well. 
One should never stop seeking ways to improve.

It seems the world hasn't swallowed you just yet. 
Good. I was beginning to wonder whether you had discovered something you weren't prepared to understand.

A familiar face. 
Tell me, have you come seeking new knowledge, or has curiosity simply brought you back?
npc.runecraftory.skill_merchant.1.hate.1:
I see... A rather peculiar choice. 
I fail to see any meaningful use for this, though I suppose the intention was yours to make.
npc.runecraftory.skill_merchant.1.like.1:
Ah... now this is interesting. 
There is more to this than meets the eye. A fine choice, %player%. Thank you.
npc.runecraftory.skill_merchant.1.marria: Marriage... A rather profound commitment. I have spent much of my life pursuing knowledge and keeping my distance from others. Yet with you, I find myself willing to reconsider. Yes, %player%. I accept.

I have witnessed countless wonders, some of which would be difficult for you to believe. Yet I suspect sharing an ordinary life with you may prove more extraordinary than any of them. I would be honored.
You wish to bind our paths together for a lifetime? Very well. There are still many mysteries I have yet to uncover, but I would rather face them with you by my side.
That is no small proposition, %player%. I would not wish to make such a promise without being entirely certain. I ask that you give me more time.
Marriage... I have never given much thought to such things. There are still parts of my life I have yet to reconcile. I cannot accept just yet.
I care for you, but there are truths about myself that I have not yet shared. Before making such a commitment, I must first decide whether I am ready to reveal them.
npc.runecraftory.skill_merchant.1.procre: Even the most profound forms of creation require time. We would be wise not to force what should happen naturally.
Patience, %player%. There is no need to rush. Some things are best left to the proper moment.
I believe we have earned a little time to ourselves. Not every moment needs to be devoted to the pursuit of something new.
npc.runecraftory.skill_merchant.1.talk.1: Magic is often misunderstood. People see the result and assume the power lies in the spell itself. But the true secret lies in the understanding behind it. Without that, even the greatest ability is little more than a dangerous trick.
npc.runecraftory.skill_merchant.1.talk.2: There are places in this world where the laws of magic behave differently. Places where abilities thought lost can still be found. I've visited a few of them. I wouldn't recommend following in my footsteps.
npc.runecraftory.skill_merchant.1.talk.3: Knowledge is a curious thing. The more you acquire, the more you realize how little you actually understand. I find that rather comforting, personally.
npc.runecraftory.skill_merchant.1.talk.4: Some abilities are forgotten for good reason. Others were simply too powerful for the people who discovered them. It is important to know the difference before pursuing either.
